Slatkin conducted the debut concert on January 20, 2005 at the Kennedy Center, which Philip Glass attended.
Solo Piano (Philip Glass album) | Solo Piano (1989) is an album of piano music composed and performed by Philip Glass.  It was produced by Kurt Munkacsi.
The Fall of the House of Usher (Glass opera) | The Fall of the House of Usher is a 1988 opera by Philip Glass to a libretto based on Poe's story by Arthur Yorinks who also worked with Glass on "The Juniper Tree".
